mainTopic: רבי שמעון's decree for two sisters, and the power of מאמר in the case of three brothers and two sisters
overview: The amud opens by asking how a ruling requiring חליצה from two sisters fits רבי שמעון, who says two sisters need neither חליצה nor יבום. The answer is a rabbinic גזירה: if a woman with an איסור מצוה were released without חליצה, people might think an איסור מצוה exempts her. The decree is also extended to her sister. The גמרא explains why no such decree is made with an ערוה: everyone knows those laws, so no one will be confused. Then a new משנה presents three brothers, two married to sisters, where the single brother did מאמר with one widow before her sister also fell to him. בית שמאי say he keeps the first woman and the sister goes free. בית הלל say he loses both, which is the case of 'woe to him'. The גמרא reads 'זו היא' as rejecting רבי יהושע's similar ruling elsewhere. Finally, רבי אלעזר explains that even for בית שמאי, מאמר only pushes away the rival woman and is not a full acquisition, and רבי אבין supports this from the word 'יקיימו' in an earlier משנה.

steps.title: רבי שמעון says two sisters need neither חליצה nor יבום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the ruling that requires חליצה, using רבי שמעון's rule that two sisters are fully exempt.
steps.simpleTranslation: But didn't רבי שמעון say that two sisters neither do חליצה nor do יבום?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the ruling of the משנה. רבי שמעון holds that two sisters who fall to the same יבם are completely exempt, so why should these sisters need חליצה?
steps.deeperAnalysis: By Torah law these women are fit for יבום, so each is the sister of a woman tied to the יבם. רבי שמעון holds that in such a case both sisters are exempt from both חליצה and יבום. That clashes with a ruling that demands חליצה here.

keyTerms.meaning: The ceremony that releases a widow from the brother-in-law, instead of יבום
Two sisters who fall to the same יבם
But isn't it so...? An opening for a challenge

phrases.english: But didn't Rabbi Shimon say:
Two sisters
neither perform chalitza nor enter levirate marriage!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the discussion by challenging the משנה's requirement of חליצה
steps.kashyaTarget: The ruling that the two sisters must do חליצה, attributed to רבי שמעון
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי שמעון elsewhere exempts two sisters from both חליצה and יבום, so requiring חליצה here contradicts him.

steps.title: A decree because of other cases of איסור מצוה
steps.stepSummary: The חליצה is only a rabbinic decree, so people won't wrongly think an איסור מצוה removes the need for חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is a decree because of the general case of an איסור מצוה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that by Torah law no חליצה is needed, but the חכמים required it as a protective decree.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If this woman were let go without חליצה, people might think the reason is her איסור מצוה, not the fact that she is a sister. They would then wrongly free every איסור מצוה woman from חליצה. So the חכמים required חליצה here to keep the general rule clear.

keyTerms.meaning: A woman forbidden to the יבם by a rabbinic 'מצוה' prohibition

phrases.english: It is a decree because of a prohibition of a מצוה in general.
phrases.notes: So people won't think every woman with an איסור מצוה is exempt from חליצה.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Rabbinic decree on top of the Torah law
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ruling seemed to contradict רבי שמעון's full exemption of two sisters
steps.terutzMaskana: By Torah law רבי שמעון still exempts them; the חליצה is a decree to protect the general rule of איסור מצוה

steps.title: Fine for her, but why her sister?
steps.stepSummary: The decree explains the woman with the איסור מצוה, but not why her sister also needs חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: That works for her. But what can be said about her sister?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on the answer. The decree fits the woman who has the איסור מצוה, but her sister has no such prohibition.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The fear of confusion only applies to the woman with the איסור מצוה. Her sister is a regular woman, so the reason given does not cover her.

phrases.english: This works out well for her,
phrases.notes: She is the woman with the איסור מצוה.

phrases.english: but her sister, what is there to say?

steps.triggerLanguage: הָא תִּינַח אִיהִי, אֲחוֹתָהּ מַאי אִיכָּא לְמֵימַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the reach of the answer in step 2
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The reason for the decree applies only to the woman with the איסור מצוה, not to her sister.

steps.title: The sister is included because of her
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים extended the decree to the sister because of the first woman.
steps.simpleTranslation: The decree on her sister is because of her.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the sister must also do חליצה, as an extension of the decree on the first woman.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since the two sisters' cases are tied together, the חכמים extended the decree to cover the sister as well.

keyTerms.meaning: Because of her, on her account

phrases.english: There is a decree on her sister because of her.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: The sister seemed to have no reason for a decree
steps.terutzMaskana: The decree was extended to the sister because of the first woman

steps.title: But with an ערוה there is no decree
steps.stepSummary: If the חכמים decree for an איסור מצוה, why don't they decree the same way when one sister is an ערוה?
steps.simpleTranslation: But with an ערוה, we don't make a decree!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a new question. When the forbidden woman is an ערוה, her sister is not required to do חליצה, so why decree here?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The same fear of confusion seems to apply when one of the women is an ערוה. Yet there the חכמים make no decree requiring חליצה because of her sister. So why decree in the case of an איסור מצוה?

phrases.english: But with regard to a forbidden relative, we don't make a decree?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the decree by comparing it to the case of ערוה
steps.kashyaTarget: The decree for איסור מצוה and her sister
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The same worry should apply to ערוה, yet no decree is made there, so the decree seems inconsistent.

steps.title: Everyone knows the laws of ערוה
steps.stepSummary: People know the laws of ערוה well and they are widely known, so no one will be confused.
steps.simpleTranslation: ערוה is different, because people learn it well and it is widely known.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that ערוה is different. Everyone knows these laws, so there is no fear of mistakes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The laws of ערוה are written in the תורה and well known, so no one will draw a wrong conclusion. An איסור מצוה is not well known, so a decree is needed only there.
steps.whatToRemember: By Torah law רבי שמעון exempts two sisters. The חכמים still required חליצה when one is an איסור מצוה, so people won't think an איסור מצוה exempts a woman, and they extended it to her sister. No decree is needed for ערוה because everyone knows those laws.

phrases.english: A forbidden relative is different,
since people have thoroughly learned it,
and it is widely known.

steps.triggerLanguage: שָׁאנֵי עֶרְוָה דְּמִגְמָר גְּמִירִי לַהּ אִינָשֵׁי
steps.terutzHavaAmina: ערוה and איסור מצוה seemed to deserve the same treatment
steps.terutzMaskana: ערוה laws are well known, so no decree is needed; an איסור מצוה is not, so a decree is needed

steps.title: New משנה: the case of three brothers and two sisters
steps.stepSummary: The משנה sets up the case: two brothers are married to sisters, one is unmarried, and a chain of deaths and a מאמר follows.
steps.simpleTranslation: Three brothers: two are married to two sisters, and one is unmarried. One of the sisters' husbands died, and the unmarried brother did מאמר with his widow. Then the second brother died.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins by laying out a case. It is only the setup; the rulings come in the next steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the first death, only one sister falls to the unmarried brother, and he does מאמר with her but does not complete the ייבום. When the second brother dies, her sister also falls to him. The question is whether that half-step of מאמר makes the first woman enough of his 'wife' to free her sister as אחות אשה.

keyTerms.meaning: A rabbinic betrothal of a יבמה, done with money or a document before full ייבום

phrases.english: Mishnah:
Three brothers,
two are married to two sisters
and one is unmarried.
One of the sisters' husbands died,
and the unmarried one did מאמר with her.
phrases.notes: He betrothed her as a יבמה but did not yet complete the ייבום.

phrases.english: And afterward his second brother died —

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new משנה after the previous discussion ends.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Setup only: the unmarried brother did מאמר with one sister, and then the other sister also fell to him for ייבום.

steps.title: בית שמאי: he keeps the first woman and the sister goes free
steps.stepSummary: בית שמאי rule that the woman he did מאמר with counts as his wife, so her sister is exempt as אחות אשה.
steps.simpleTranslation: בית שמאי say: His wife stays with him, and this other woman goes out because she is his wife's sister.
steps.whatsHappening: בית שמאי give their ruling on the case. They treat the מאמר as strong enough to make the first woman 'his wife'.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because the first woman counts as his wife, the second sister is אחות אשה to him, which is an ערוה. So she is fully exempt from ייבום and חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: A wife's sister, forbidden as an ערוה
She goes out (is released without ייבום)

phrases.english: Beit Shammai say:
His wife is with him,
phrases.notes: 'His wife' means the woman he did מאמר with.

phrases.english: and this other one goes out because she is a wife's sister.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the first ruling on the case set up in step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For בית שמאי, the מאמר makes the first sister his wife, and the second sister is exempt as אחות אשה.

steps.title: בית הלל: he loses both women
steps.stepSummary: בית הלל rule that he must release his 'wife' with a גט and חליצה and release the sister with חליצה, which is the case of 'woe to him'.
steps.simpleTranslation: בית הלל say: He releases his wife with a גט and חליצה, and his brother's wife with חליצה. This is what they meant when they said: Woe to him over his wife, and woe to him over his brother's wife.
steps.whatsHappening: בית הלל disagree with בית שמאי. Since the first marriage was never completed, both women are bound to him, so he cannot marry either one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For בית הלל, מאמר does not make the first woman fully his wife. Both sisters are tied to him at once, and he cannot do ייבום with two sisters, so he must free both. The first needs a גט to undo the מאמר and חליצה to undo the ייבום bond. The second needs חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: The ceremony that releases a יבמה from ייבום

steps.whatToRemember: בית שמאי: the מאמר wife stays, and the sister goes free. בית הלל: he loses both, with a גט plus חליצה for the first and חליצה for the second.

phrases.english: And Beit Hillel say:
He sends away his wife with a bill of divorce and with חליצה,
and his brother's wife with חליצה.
This is what they said:
Woe to him over his wife,
and woe to him over his brother's wife.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים: מוֹצִיא אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ בְּגֵט וּבַחֲלִיצָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing ruling to בית שמאי in step 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For בית הלל, he must release both sisters: the first with a גט and חליצה, the second with חליצה.

steps.title: What do the words 'זו היא' come to exclude?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the precise phrase 'זו היא' in the משנה is meant to leave out.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins and asks about the wording 'זו היא', which sounds like 'this case and only this case'. It is setting up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Saying 'this is the case of woe to him' suggests that some other case might wrongly be called 'woe to him'. The גמרא wants to know which case that is.

keyTerms.meaning: 'This is it,' wording that limits to this case

phrases.english: Gemara:
"This is" comes to exclude what?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks about the wording at the end of בית הלל's ruling in step 9.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which other case the limiting phrase 'זו היא' leaves out.

steps.title: It excludes רבי יהושע's 'woe to him' ruling
steps.stepSummary: The phrase excludes רבי יהושע's similar 'woe to him' ruling, which we do not follow. Instead we follow רבן גמליאל or רבי אלעזר.
steps.simpleTranslation: It excludes that ruling of רבי יהושע, because we do not act like him. Rather, we act either like רבן גמליאל or like רבי אלעזר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that 'זו היא' means only this case is 'woe to him', not the case where רבי יהושע used the same phrase.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהושע said 'woe to him' in a different case, where he would lose both women. The משנה here hints that we do not rule like him there. In that case we follow רבן גמליאל or רבי אלעזר, who give him a way to keep one of the women.

keyTerms.meaning: A תנא whose 'woe to him' ruling is rejected here
We act according to his view
A תנא in that other dispute

steps.confusionAlert: The רבי אלעזר named here is one of the opinions in that other משנה. The רבי אלעזר in the next step gives his own explanation in the גמרא. Don't mix the two statements together.

phrases.english: To exclude that one of Rabbi Yehoshua,
phrases.notes: That's a later משנה in this מסכת, where רבי יהושע also says 'woe to him' about a man married to a minor whose sister falls to him.

phrases.english: that we do not act like him.
Rather, either like Rabban Gamliel,
or like Rabbi Elazar.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: 'זו היא' excludes רבי יהושע's 'woe to him' case, showing that the halacha there follows רבן גמליאל or רבי אלעזר.
steps.whyThisMatters: A single limiting word in the משנה is read as a hidden פסק about a completely different משנה.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר: for בית שמאי, מאמר only pushes away the צרה
steps.stepSummary: רבי אלעזר clarifies that for בית שמאי, מאמר is not a full acquisition. It only pushes away the competing woman.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אלעזר said: Don't say that for בית שמאי, מאמר acquires completely, so that if he wants to release her a גט alone is enough. Rather, for בית שמאי, מאמר acquires only to push away the צרה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אלעזר limits how far בית שמאי's ruling goes. The מאמר does not make her a full wife; it only blocks the other woman.
steps.deeperAnalysis: From step 8, one might think בית שמאי treat מאמר like full ייבום, so a גט alone would free her. רבי אלעזר says no: she would still need חליצה. The מאמר's power is limited to pushing the second woman out of ייבום.

keyTerms.meaning: A rival woman tied to the same יבם

steps.whatToRemember: Even for בית שמאי, מאמר is not full marriage. It only pushes away the other woman, and the first woman still needs חליצה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Elazar said:
Do not say that מאמר, according to Beit Shammai,
acquires with a complete acquisition,
so that if he wants to send her away
a bill of divorce is enough for her,
rather, מאמר according to Beit Shammai
acquires only
to push away the rival wife alone.
phrases.notes: In our משנה, the 'rival' is the second sister, who falls to the same brother.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: לָא תֵּימָא מַאֲמָר לְבֵית שַׁמַּאי קוֹנֶה קִנְיָן גָּמוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to בית שמאי's ruling in step 8 and defines its limits.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For בית שמאי, מאמר is not a complete acquisition (releasing her still needs חליצה). Its only power is to push away the צרה.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that בית שמאי's 'his wife is with him' does not mean full marriage, which shapes how the coming גמרא discusses the strength of מאמר.

steps.title: רבי אבין finds support in an earlier משנה
steps.stepSummary: רבי אבין supports רבי אלעזר from the משנה at the start of the פרק. בית שמאי say 'יקיימו', which means after the fact yes, but from the start no.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אבין said: We also learned this in a משנה. בית שמאי say: 'They may keep them.' 'They may keep them' means yes after the fact, but not from the start.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אבין brings a proof for רבי אלעזר's point from step 12. He points to the exact word בית שמאי used in an earlier משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the earlier משנה, two sisters fell to two brothers, and the brothers married them without asking בית דין. בית שמאי only said 'יקיימו', meaning they may keep them now that it is done, not that marrying them was allowed from the start. This shows that for בית שמאי, the levirate tie on its own (without a full marriage) still pushes the other sister away, which fits רבי אלעזר's idea that מאמר pushes away without being full קנין.

keyTerms.meaning: We too have learned it. This opens a proof from a משנה or ברייתא.
They may keep them, meaning they may stay married.
After the fact, once it has already been done.
The levirate tie between a יבם and a יבמה before יבום.

steps.whatToRemember: The precise word 'יקיימו' teaches 'after the fact yes, from the start no.' רבי אבין uses this to support רבי אלעזר: for בית שמאי, מאמר pushes the other woman away but is not a full marriage.
steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two משניות. 'יקיימו' comes from the משנה at the start of the פרק, about two sisters and two brothers. It does not come from the מאמר case we were just learning.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows how one carefully chosen word in a משנה can reveal a whole legal view. Here the word 'יקיימו' supports רבי אלעזר's reading of בית שמאי.

phrases.english: Rabbi Avin said:
We too have also learned this in a Mishnah:
phrases.notes: 'This' is רבי אלעזר's point from just before: for בית שמאי, מאמר isn't a full acquisition.

phrases.english: Beit Shammai say: They may keep them.
phrases.notes: This is from the משנה at the start of our פרק: two sisters fell to two brothers, who married them before asking בית דין.

phrases.english: "They may keep them": yes, after the fact,
but from the start, no.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a proof from a משנה for רבי אלעזר's statement in step 12.
steps.raayaObject: רבי אלעזר's claim that for בית שמאי, מאמר is not full קנין but only pushes away the competing woman.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה at the start of the פרק (26a), where בית שמאי say 'יקיימו', read as allowed after the fact but not from the start.
